title: Continuous module pullback preserves flat-term K-flat complexes
statement: For essentially small sites C,D and a representably flat continuous F:C→D, commutative ring sheaves R,S and φ:R→F_*S, let L be an additive left adjoint to the specified continuous module pushforward. If P is K-flat over R with flat terms, then its termwise image under L is K-flat over S. The coefficient and module universe contains all site universes, but their object and morphism universes remain independent. K-flatness is [def-pc-kflat-complex], inverse image is [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image].

proof.text: The flat site functor induces a finite-limit-preserving inverse image of set sheaves by Kan extension and sheafification. Construct the algebraic inverse image of R using its transported operation graphs and the generalized inverse-image construction.

Transpose φ to the structural map from the inverse-image ring to S. Restrict the underlying geometric adjunction to maps preserving addition and scalar multiplication, and compose it with the tensor/restriction adjunction. This gives the tensor pullback as left adjoint to precisely the specified module pushforward.

Apply the existing ringed-topos K-flat preservation theorem to that tensor pullback and the flat-term K-flat P. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives an isomorphism with L. Its induced cochain isomorphism transports K-flatness by the acyclic-test definition.

      SheafOfModules.{max w c v d z} ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max w c v d z}
        RingCat.{max w c v d z})).obj S))

    (P : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{max w c v d z} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max w c v d z}
